title: Advano appoints J. Christopher York as Chief Executive Officer to lead the transition to an application oriented enterprise advancing silicon-carbon composite battery materials
summary: Advano appoints J. Christopher York as Chief Executive Officer to lead the transition to an application oriented enterprise
body_markdown:
New Orleans, Jan. 11, 2024 —


Advano, a silicon solutions provider, is accelerating the commercialization of its proprietary silicon anode “drop-in” technology, REALSi™. The transition to an application-oriented enterprise has been made possible with the new leadership of J. Christopher York and further advancements in Advano’s silicon-carbon composite battery materials.


[(See the original posting on PR Newswire.)](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/advano-appoints-j-christopher-york-as-chief-executive-officer-to-lead-the-transition-to-an-application-oriented-enterprise-advancing-silicon-carbon-composite-battery-materials-302032997.html)
